comment: svl.lastseentyp[][] across #wizloaddes: clear_level_structures() replaces the level structure but leaves the game-wide grid, which only init_mapseen() clears. Loading soko4-1 over the first level premaps it (seen vectors set, lastseentyp untouched), so #terrain's known-terrain view (detect.c reveal_terrain()) draws each premapped square from what the hero last saw there before the load: the first level's room where they overlap and stone elsewhere. Seed, date and Ranger chosen independently.
